family: The single total deterministic certificate-free language in family.py and proof.md. For N>=2 set L=floor(log2 N), J=ceil(log2(L+2)), k=floor(2^10000*L^25/J); k>N or failed exact metadata shapes return zero. Set m=floor(k/(2^300*L^2)), h=pow2ceil(2^200*L^2), ell=2^500*L^4, E=2^200*L^2; use the supplied degree-64 orbit short extractor, indexed alternating extraction and monotone polynomial-graph resilient disperser. All actual input bits are payload; every field choice is uniform. There is no advice, witness input or field-polynomial prefix, and the runtime is one fixed polynomial with an enormous degree.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exist fixed K>0 and N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-K*(log2 N)^25/(log2 log2 N) for every integer actual length N>=N0 in the full pinned B2 model. The proof supplies affine dispersal at the exact dimension k in the family definition and applies the complete kernel 4N-8(d+1). All material component and borderline fixed-factor accounting arguments are supplied. The same complete guarantee implies the joint finite projection (4,1).
